* Own the effective use and continuous improvement of quality management system software, including document control, audits, corrective actions, training records, verification, and reporting.

The Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the organization’s food manufacturing operations.
* Build a culture of accountability, prevention, compliance, and continuous improvement across Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other partner functions.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product or process deviations, and recurring issues; ensure root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Demonstrated knowledge of food safety principles, quality assurance procedures and policies, HACCP-based programs, risk assessment, corrective action, and preventive controls.
